cases.case_label: Known de novo Alu insertion in NF1 (sample CN1)
cases.mechanism_detail: Methods paper: a previously genotyped NF1 sample (CN1) carrying a de novo Alu insertion was used to test capture-NGS; the insertion was only partially detected. Location and mechanism not described.
cases.quote: The de novo Alu insertion was partially detected in sample CN1 by additional de novo assembly with 50% base-match stringency
